mathematical_meanings: Left image: The shading designates the interior area of the rectangle. Right image: The shaded half-plane is the solution region of a strict linear inequality.
Rationales: The feature selects a geometric area in the left image and selects the solution half-plane of a linear inequality in the right image. The lavender rectangle with dimensions 3 cm and 2 cm. The gray half-plane to the right of the falling dashed boundary.
